description: Research current information with browser web search and rendered pages, plus scholarly and Wikipedia sources. Verify primary evidence, dates and citations.

function.name: browser_search
function.description: Search Google in Chromium for current information. Returns titles, source links and concise snippets, summarizing long text and key figures without saving originals. Open sources to verify evidence; paginate when needed.

limit.description: Results to show from this Google page; default 10. Use page for further results.

snippet_chars.description: Snippet summary size, up to 400 characters; default 400. Open the source for further evidence.

function.name: browser_open
function.description: Read a source, summarizing large content into main points and key figures with units, dates and context. Originals are discarded. Use focus to retrieve missing details. Runs JavaScript in Chromium.

wait_for.description: Optional CSS selector to await dynamic content.

max_chars.description: Summary size in characters, up to 8000; default 8000. Large originals are not returned or saved.

link_offset.description: Link offset; default 0. Use next_link_offset for more links.

max_links.description: Links to return; default 10. Set 0 to omit links.

focus.description: Optional question or topic to prioritize when summarizing the entire source.

function.name: search_wikipedia
function.description: Search English Wikipedia for orientation. Follow references to primary sources before making detailed claims.

limit.description: Requested results per source page; default 10. Source service limits apply.

function.name: search_papers
function.description: Search Crossref publication metadata, DOI links and available abstracts. This does not fetch full papers.

limit.description: Requested results per source page; default 10. Source service limits apply.

function.name: read_webpage
function.description: Read a source, summarizing large content into main points and key figures with units, dates and context. Originals are discarded. Use focus to retrieve missing details. Use browser_open for JavaScript-rendered pages.

url.description: Exact source URL from results, references or the user.

max_chars.description: Summary size in characters, up to 8000; default 8000. Large originals are not returned or saved.

link_offset.description: Link offset; default 0. Use next_link_offset for more links.

max_links.description: Links to return; default 10. Set 0 to omit links.

focus.description: Optional question or topic to prioritize when summarizing the entire source.
